title: A cooled glow
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: As the universe expanded, the wavelength of the early radiation stretched. The once much hotter radiation is now observed as a cool microwave background.

misconception: A learner may choose: The radiation was created by microwave ovens
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Why is the cosmic microwave background observed today at microwave wavelengths?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Why is the cosmic microwave background observed today at microwave wavelengths? Expansion stretched the original radiation's wavelengths. As the universe expanded, the wavelength of the early radiation stretched. The once much hotter radiation is now observed as a cool microwave background.
Visual caption: Expansion stretches the glow. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: Why is the cosmic microwave background observed today at microwave wavelengths?
options: The radiation was created by microwave ovens
The light has never changed wavelength
Expansion stretched the original radiation's wavelengths
recall.why: As the universe expanded, the wavelength of the early radiation stretched. The once much hotter radiation is now observed as a cool microwave background.
